author: RichBrigg
quote:
Awful. Journalists have no soul, back bone, or are paid shills. Can’t offend big daddy, game of the year Rockstar. Where did the 13 years, 1 to 2 billion go? Aside from the graphics and world design, this is a failure. Rockstar did not escape the triple A collapse. I was a fool. I was duped and robbed. Thankfully I got my money back. You lost your fan base Rockstar. This is Grand Neuter, Sim Simulator, poor performer console destroyer, play it safe, Theft Auto. Wait for the online subscriptions lol. Game as we know it is over. Private equity and billionaires will flood the industry after the record sales of this game, and in time we will see the result. 

The NBA ad on the button isn’t allowing me to submit the review. I can’t click the X button. Coincidence? Anything to deter consumer reviews.
